within_partition_text_order: original source index, sentences joined by newline
test_evaluation: all complete chunks in held-out fold; discard incomplete tail
probe_evaluation: first 64 complete chunks in probe fold; require at least 64
ranker_fit_source: stage-49 fit rows, grouped logistic selection from stage 53; freeze before PUD scoring
reference: canonical update alignment with probe gradient
primary: Arabic top-two regret: corrected ranker minus baseline ranker
secondary: corrected ranker minus alignment within each language
aggregation: average ten held-out fold metrics within each model seed, then paired seed contrast
superiority_rule: upper confidence bound below zero for the Arabic primary contrast
limitations: No independent pooling of parallel languages
Folds share training sentences and are not independent samples
Eight seeds provide conditional uncertainty only
Not an official UD parsing benchmark
